scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Centenarian
other_conditions: Must be an Indian individual above ninety years of age and physically active, independent, and contributing to society
Should have rendered exemplary services for the betterment of the community and society at large
Must have fought against social evils and for the freedom of the Nation
Should demonstrate ongoing commitment especially for the cause of the elderly or other marginalized sections of society
Contribution should have wide recognition from society
Must possess reasonable good health and continue actively participating in social causes
Should have participated on various State and National level platforms
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized nominating agency or individual; self‑nominations are not considered

Nominations can be made only by authorized agencies such as Government ministries, state/UT administrations, past awardees of national awards, members of the National Council of Senior Citizens, recognized apex chambers, or any other person/institution authorized by the Ministry
Open to all Indian individuals without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed
benefits_summary: Award includes a citation, a memento and a cash prize of ₹2,50,000, plus travel, lodging and related expenses for the awardee and one companion.
